name: ANSI/IEEE coaxial connector symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented coaxial connector symbol showing mating centre and outer contacts for a coaxial cable.
description: IEEE-style schematics show a coaxial connector as a centre contact within an outer shell outline, often with the shell tied to ground. US-practice drawings label coaxial jacks with J reference designators and plugs with P, following IEEE reference designation practice.

This is an independently drawn explanation, not the IEEE graphic. Connector series and impedance must still be given. Where the shell is grounded at the panel, the outer conductor of the cable is grounded there too, which affects ground loop analysis.
readingNotes: Read J or P designations to identify jack or plug.
Check shell grounding at the panel.
drawingChecklist: Use J and P designators consistently.
distinction: An ANSI coaxial connector mates concentric contacts; the ANSI plug and socket pair mates single conductors.
